utterances.text: Hi, Daniel. Thanks for making time. I'm Maya Chen. I lead product on the onboarding project.
Hi, Maya. I'm Daniel Okafor.
I'm the back end engineer on the same project.
Let's go through the list.
First one is the duplicate welcome email. Two users reported it this week.
I've already reproduced it. I'll fix the duplicate welcome email, and I'll have it merged by the end of the week.
Good. That one is yours then.
Second, the onboarding checklist copy still says beta.
I'll rewrite it. I can have the new copy ready by Tuesday.
Tuesday is tight. The design review is on Tuesday morning.
Fair point. Let me correct that. I'll deliver the new checklist copy by Thursday instead.
Thursday works.
We could also add a progress bar to the import screen. It might reduce the drop off.
We could, but I don't want to commit to that today.
Let's leave it as an idea.
Fine. It stays an idea. Nobody is picking it up.
Now about the migration script.
Last week, I said I would write one for the legacy accounts.
Yes. That was agreed.
Cancel it. Operations migrated those accounts manually yesterday,
so the script is not needed anymore.
Understood.
The migration script is canceled.
The release runbook is out of date. Someone needs to update it before we ship.
Agreed. The runbook must be updated before the release.
We are not deciding who does that right now.
One more thing. Do we need legal to review the new consent text?
I don't know. I have not asked them.
Let's leave that open until we get an answer.
Anything else?
No.
That's everything.
Thanks, Daniel.
